compte_page.privacy_opt_out_title: Do not link my visits to my account
compte_page.privacy_opt_out_detail: When you are signed in, the pages you view are linked to your account to help us improve the service. Turn this on to keep them anonymous. Nothing else changes.
compte_page.privacy_opt_out_saved: Done: your visits are no longer linked to your account.
compte_page.privacy_opt_in_saved: Your visits are linked to your account again.
compte_page.privacy_opt_out_device_only: Saved on this device. Saving to your account failed: try again later to apply it to your other devices.
